verdict.root_cause: At 15:11:20 platform-automation updated cartservice's image reference to a hotfix build tag, and the cart-service log stream stops one second earlier with a graceful shutdown notice and never resumes [tr_512ff0e2c8b9, tr_3a90a5ddf3d0]. From then on cartservice is not serving: every sampled failing checkout trace is an identical 5-span shape whose deepest ERROR span is checkoutservice's outbound GetCart leaf, failing in 2-4ms with nearly all self time there and no payment/currency/email/accounting spans attempted [tr_ad0617b749d9]. checkoutservice itself is healthy - continuous PlaceOrder traffic, no error lines, no restart, and no recorded change in 24 hours [tr_8c2821730748, tr_dd616f17d83c]. The mechanism is that the artifact now referenced for cartservice is not running after the old process was stopped for the swap; frontend and loadgenerator alarms are the propagated form of the same error.
verdict.reasoning: Traces place the error origin two levels below the alerting services, at checkoutservice's GetCart leaf, and rule out the frontend, checkoutservice's own handler, the shipping-quote path, and the never-invoked payment/currency/email/accounting dependencies; the 3-7ms fast-fail excludes deadline exhaustion or a slow-but-alive dependency [tr_ad0617b749d9]. Logs put cartservice out of service from 15:11:19 with an orderly shutdown and no later lines [tr_3a90a5ddf3d0], one second before the image-reference update by automation [tr_512ff0e2c8b9]. The other cartservice change candidates were not live at onset - alternate REDIS_ADDR reverted ~2.8h prior, traffic-shaping delay detached ~3.1h prior [tr_512ff0e2c8b9] - removing bad_config and injected-latency readings. checkoutservice's incident-window error mean sits below its own baseline with the only change point at 15:13:30, late and consistent with a downstream failure arriving [tr_e9eaf753a6e6].
open_questions: No pod/container lifecycle evidence was collected for cartservice after 15:11:20, so whether the hotfix image failed to pull, crash-looped, or started under a different log label was never observed directly.
cartservice has no calls_total series in either window, so its rate, latency and error onset are unmeasurable [tr_0dce99e5360a].

The ~3.5 minute gap between the 15:11:19 shutdown and the 15:14:45 alerts is unaccounted for, and the image update is one step of a recurring five-stage automation cycle whose earlier iterations were not checked [tr_512ff0e2c8b9].

alternatives.root_cause: cartservice was stopped for the image swap and never brought back up due to a stalled orchestration or pull backoff, rather than a defective artifact.
alternatives.why_not: Not separable on the evidence gathered, but the image update landing one second after the shutdown ties the outage to the deploy step; re-pointing at the prior artifact covers both readings [tr_512ff0e2c8b9, tr_3a90a5ddf3d0].

alternatives.root_cause: cartservice is up but its redis backing store is unreachable, so GetCart fails fast at the cart tier.
alternatives.why_not: The last REDIS_ADDR override was reverted ~2.8h before onset and no cache-connection failure appears in cart logs; the log stream also ends entirely, which a serving-but-failing process would not do [tr_512ff0e2c8b9, tr_3a90a5ddf3d0].

proposal.expected_effect: The cart-service log stream, silent since the 15:11:19 shutdown notice, resumes GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync lines within a minute; newly sampled checkout traces stop showing an ERROR leaf on checkoutservice->hipstershop.CartService/GetCart and extend into shipping/payment/currency spans; checkoutservice logs resume the completion entries that currently follow no PlaceOrder; its error ratio falls back toward the ~0.098 baseline with no repeat of the 15:13:30 ~0.67 excursion. cartservice's own metrics cannot confirm this - calls_total is absent for it in both windows.
proposal.if_wrong: Falsified if cart-service logs stay empty after the recreate (prior tag also fails to start, or the process logs under another label - no lifecycle evidence was ever collected), if it starts then shuts down again within minutes, or if checkout traces keep the identical 5-span shape with a 2-4ms ERROR GetCart leaf, which would place the fault in the path to cart rather than the image. The image update is step one of a recurring five-stage platform-automation cycle, so recovery that reverses at the next iteration means the real fix is halting that automation, which is outside this system's actions.
proposal.risk: If cartservice is actually running, this destroys a working container: connections reset and in-process cache is lost during the recreate. The pre-change value is recorded as None, so the target tag is inferred from the cycle rather than observed; if it is unpullable or also broken, cartservice stays down in a state indistinguishable from now, and the automation may re-apply the hotfix, producing flapping harder to read than the current steady failure.
proposal.blast_radius: cartservice's inbound caller checkoutservice sees GetCart connection resets during the recreate, propagating to frontend and loadgenerator, which are already alarming. No other service's traffic moves.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical alerts firing simultaneously on checkout and frontend plus the load generator indicate a real user-facing failure that cannot be dismissed. The shared downstream set under checkout offers no single obvious culprit yet, so the fault class stays unknown.
